title: Terms to Enterprise Knowledge Graph
description: Interactive infographic MicroSim of the ten steps to move from a simple list of business terms to an agentic EKG
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Sequence the ten stages from a raw Terms List through Business Glossary, Controlled Vocabulary, Taxonomy, Ontology, and Semantic Ontology to a Real-Time EKG
Distinguish a Business Glossary's informal definitions from a Controlled Vocabulary's single authoritative ISO-11179 definitions
Compare a Taxonomy's broader/narrower hierarchy with an Ontology's richer synonym, related-term, and part-whole relationships
Explain how a Semantic Ontology's formally typed relationships (partOf, causedBy, requires) enable logical reasoning that earlier stages cannot support
Identify what an AI Enhanced EKG and a Real-Time EKG add beyond a static Enterprise Knowledge Graph
